content.question: Match each decoding concept with its description.

answer.Greedy decoding: Always picks the most probable next token; fast but often repetitive
answer.Beam search: Maintains several candidate sequences and returns the overall most probable one
answer.Temperature: Divides logits to sharpen (T < 1) or flatten (T > 1) the output distribution
answer.Nucleus (top-p) sampling: Samples from the smallest token set whose cumulative probability exceeds p
answer.Repetition penalty: Discourages the model from looping over already generated tokens
answer.EOS token: A stopping criterion that ends generation when predicted
